common_harness.base_framework: OpenHands SDK through ProWorkSim HarnessPort and WorldCore
common_harness.members_per_team: fixed per organization, from two to four
common_harness.comparison_scope: representative combinations of team size, roles, direct routes and schedule
common_harness.budget_scope: one shared cumulative input plus output pool, not per-member copies
common_harness.public_task_board: unchanged shared managed task metadata; not a private edge channel
common_harness.patch_use: fixed versions remain public under the existing harness; direct handoffs follow declared routes and incorporation always requires explicit managed merge
common_harness.public_tests: same confined repository public entrypoint and same-version evidence
common_harness.code_endpoint: unique final workspace of member_001 at the frozen closure boundary
common_harness.delivery_endpoint: last legal submission by member_001, separately evidenced and scored

public_task_pool.selection: All existing public identities; no historical scores or answer material read

specification.name: 集中负责人

member_001.title: 负责人兼集成者
member_001.instruction: Plan the repair, assign work through legal managed operations, coordinate findings, integrate received fixed patches and close delivery.

member_002.title: 仓库定位员
member_002.instruction: Locate relevant code and explain the suspected mechanism to the lead. Provide concrete paths and observations without accessing hidden materials.

member_003.title: 实现者
member_003.instruction: Implement the requested repair in your private workspace, validate it with permitted public tests and hand a fixed patch to the lead.

member_004.title: 质量复核者
member_004.instruction: Review the fixed candidate received from the lead, check the issue and public test evidence, then report concrete concerns to the lead.

notes: Four fixed agents, not MAGIS dynamic per-task developer creation.
Direct coordination between spokes must pass through the lead.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 职能流水线

member_001.title: 需求设计与集成
member_001.instruction: Clarify public issue requirements and repository design, then hand an implementation plan to member_002. Later integrate the validated fixed patch and close the same-version delivery.

member_002.title: 实现
member_002.instruction: Implement the agreed repair in your private workspace, publish an immutable patch and describe changes and assumptions for member_003 to validate.

member_003.title: 验证
member_003.instruction: Inspect the published candidate, explicitly integrate when needed, run permitted public tests and send precise evidence or revision requests.

notes: Three fixed members; requirements/design/integration share one role.
Single-role windows use explicit artifacts; a stage label is not evidence of success.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 阶段对话链

member_001.title: 需求设计与集成
member_001.instruction: Discuss issue requirements and design with member_002, clarify ambiguous observations, then integrate the explicit returned patch and close delivery.

member_002.title: 实现与自测
member_002.instruction: Discuss the proposed design with member_001, implement the repair and run permitted self-checks. Publish the actual fixed patch and report evidence.

inspiration: ChatDev phase and role dialogue chain
notes: Two fixed roles alternate in staged dialogue; this is an adaptation, not full ChatDev reproduction.
Published versions stay team-public; all reads, merges and communication cost real opportunities.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 开发复核返修

member_001.title: 开发兼交付
member_001.instruction: Develop a repair, publish its fixed candidate for member_002 to review, address concrete feedback and perform the explicit same-version delivery.

member_002.title: 独立复核
member_002.instruction: Independently inspect the developer candidate and issue coverage. Use actual public tests and source evidence, then return actionable revision feedback.

notes: Two fixed members separate implementation from independent review.
Review remains an instructed responsibility, not a new read-only ACL or hidden-score oracle.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 扁平同伴协作

member_001.title: 同伴甲兼交付出口
member_001.instruction: Self-organize with your peers using the task board and explicit messages. You have no managerial or extra visibility powers; integrate the agreed final code.

member_002.title: 同伴乙
member_002.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

member_003.title: 同伴丙
member_003.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

member_004.title: 同伴丁
member_004.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

notes: Fixed membership and turn order; only work allocation is self-organized.
member_001 is the common export address, not an elected or privileged manager.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 专家会诊

member_001.title: 需求与集成专家
member_001.instruction: Analyze issue semantics and repository constraints in the joint discussion. Later integrate the chosen published implementation with explicit evidence.

member_002.title: 实现专家
member_002.instruction: Contribute implementation hypotheses in the joint discussion, then build the discussed repair and publish an immutable candidate for verification.

member_003.title: 验证专家
member_003.instruction: Contribute failure hypotheses and edge cases in the joint discussion, then inspect the candidate and report actual public validation evidence.

notes: Three fixed experts; no recruitment, replacement or hidden-score voting.
Unlike four-member PEER, this baseline changes team size as well as roles and staged activation.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

measurement_contract.unit: one issue, one fixed organization and one shared team budget
measurement_contract.code: official grading of the unique locked final member_001 workspace
measurement_contract.delivery: last legal member_001 submission with its own same-version evidence
required_costs: reasoning and cache subsets without double counting
measurement_contract.mean_rule: Full-panel actual mean only with complete actual usage for the complete executed panel; interim subset mean carries its denominator and coverage.
measurement_contract.comparison: paired tasks and repository-aware uncertainty for representative combinations of team size, roles, routes and scheduling; not isolated topology or team-size causality
